subject: AsterBio security intake: availability, scope, and evidence intake plan
messages:
From: Tom Hall <tom.hall@asterbio.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Perez <lina.perez@asterbio.com>, security@asterbio.com
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial SIG/CAIQ request and suggested timeline

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this. We're running a tighter timeline internally and trying to finish vendor SOC/SIG intake for Q1. Attached is a short packet with our questionnaire and the items we typically request (SIG + a trimmed CAIQ). Can the Redwood team do an intake call this week to confirm scope, ETA for attachments, and where to drop evidence?

High level asks from our side:
- Walk-through of which controls are covered by hosted vs private deployments (we have a mix of workloads).
- Confirmation of log retention windows and log formats for audit exports.
- A named owner and ETA for sample artifacts (e.g., config screenshots, architecture diagram, encryption key management summary).

Our preferred times: Tue 2026-02-10 morning PST or Wed 2026-02-11 afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Hall
Head of Security Operations
AsterBio
[attachment: AsterBio_SIG_Request_v1.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hall <tom.hall@asterbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/CAIQ request and suggested timeline

Hi Tom — appreciate the packet and the timeline. Marissa, David, and Steph are looping in to cover evidence and logging items. Quick answers up front and a couple of suggested next steps: 

1) Availability: We can do Tue 02/10 at 9:30am PST (30–45 minutes) or Wed 02/11 at 2:00pm PST. Which works best for your engineering/security leads?

2) Hosted vs Private: We'll prepare a short matrix in the call showing which controls apply to Hosted API versus Dedicated/Private deployments — that should help you map control expectations.

3) Evidence intake: We use a shared Drive folder for artifacts; I'll create a scoped folder for AsterBio and send the link before the call. Please use the attached inventory template for mapping items to owners and delivery ETA.

Agenda proposal (30–45m):
- 5m introductions & scope
- 10m deployment/control coverage matrix
- 10m artifact owners & delivery cadence (who will own each attachment)
- 10m open questions (logs, retention, export samples) + next steps

We'll be prepared with a preliminary owners list based on what you send back in the template.

Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Security & Trust Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Inline: evidence_inventory_template.xlsx attached for intake]

From: Lina Perez <lina.perez@asterbio.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Tom Hall <tom.hall@asterbio.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 13:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/CAIQ request and suggested timeline

Thanks, Irene. Wed 02/11 2pm PST works best for our team. I'll invite our infra lead and procurement (so we can cover any contract/redline questions in the same call). Looking forward to the Drive link and the template.

—Lina
Lina Perez
Vendor Risk Analyst
AsterBio

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Perez <lina.perez@asterbio.com>, Tom Hall <tom.hall@asterbio.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/CAIQ request and suggested timeline — prep items

Hi Lina / Tom — thanks for confirming Wed 2pm. Couple of prep notes from Redwood's side:

- I've created the shared folder and uploaded the intake template plus a brief "what to expect" doc (link below). We'll ask you to fill the "owner" and "ETA" columns in the template before the call if possible; that makes the call much more action-oriented.
- For logs: our default audit/log export format is gzipped JSON lines. We can provide a 7‑day and a 90‑day sample export (filtered for non-production data if needed). Please confirm which time window you want for the sample.
- For encryption/KMS: David will cover the key lifecycle and KMS integrations; he'll bring the diagram and a short summary you can include as an artifact.
- For architecture: we'll post an architecture diagram that highlights boundaries between hosted and dedicated environments, and a sketch of ingress/egress flow.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AsterBio-SIG-Onboarding (folder contains: evidence_inventory_template.xlsx, what-to-expect.pdf, CAIQ_v4_subset.pdf)

Action items (before Wed call):
- AsterBio: fill the template owner/eta columns for any items you expect us to provide (or mark N/A).
- Redwood: post log sample and architecture diagram to the folder by Tue EOD.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: evidence_inventory_template.xlsx]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hall <tom.hall@asterbio.com>, Lina Perez <lina.perez@asterbio.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 07:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/CAIQ request and suggested timeline — log sample details

Quick technical note for the artifact checklist:

- Log sample options: 7-day raw export (gz JSONL), 90-day aggregated export (gz CSV summary), or a redacted subset (JSONL) that strips PII fields. If you need schema, see the README I've uploaded.
- Retention policy: default application logs are retained 90 days hot, then archived for 2 years in cold storage (audit exports available on request).
- For the call, we'll show an example query to reproduce an audit trail (this is useful for your compliance team).

Please tell us whether you prefer the redacted 7-day sample or the full 7-day sample for Wed so we can stage it in the shared folder.

Thanks,
David
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: logs_readme.md]

From: Tom Hall <tom.hall@asterbio.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/CAIQ request and suggested timeline — confirmed and next steps

Team — thanks for the prep and the links. We prefer the redacted 7-day JSONL sample (PII removed) plus the architecture diagram. Our procurement rep will bring contract questions but won't block the intake — we'll surface redlines after the call if needed.

Confirmed Wed 02/11 14:00 PST. I've added our infra lead (Ben Carter) to the invite. See you then; we'll fill the owner/ETA columns this evening.

Tom
Tom Hall
Head of Security Operations
AsterBio
[attachment: AsterBio_SIG_Request_v1.pdf — referenced above]
